title: Fake Customs Package
scenario: A message says souvenirs shipped home need import duty through a link.

answers.A: Track the parcel through the courier or postal service official site.
answers.B: Pay the customs duty through the message link.
answers.C: Call the courier using a number from the original shipping receipt.
answers.D: Reply with the parcel number so the courier can match the shipment.

explanation: Customs fees can be real, but the link may not be. Verify the parcel and fee through the courier you used.
proTip: Use the tracking number on the receipt, not the tracking link in the message.
